senses.gloss:
mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Of a good family, well-born.
m. (-लः)
A worshipper of Śakti according to the left hand ritual.
n. (-लं)
The doctrine and practices of the left hand Śāktas.
E.
कुल a family, and अञ् aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Of a good family, well-born.
m. (-यः)
The son of an unchaste woman.
E.
कुलक family, and ढक् aff.

mf. (-यः-यी)
1 The son or daughter of a female beg gar.
2 A bastard.
E.
कुलटा a female beggar, ढक् affix, and इनञ् inserted; also without the augment कौलटेय.

mf. (-यः-यी)
1 The child of a female beggar.
2 A bastard, the child of an unchaste wife: see the preceding.

mf. (-रः-रा)
A bastard son or daughter of a disloyal wife.
2 The child of a beggar.
E.
कुलटा an unchaste woman, द्रक aff.

mfn. (-त्थः-त्थी-त्थं)
Made, prepared, consisting of a kind of vetch.
E.
कुलत्थ Dolichos biflorus, अण् aff.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
A field, &c. of Dolichos biflorus.
E.
कुलत्थ, and खञ् affix; see the preceding.

m. (-वः)
One of the astrological periods called Karaṇas.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Made by a potter.
n. (-कं)
Earthenware, porcelain.
E.
कुलाल, and वुज् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Ancestral, heritable in the family, belonging to it, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 A heretic, an impostor.
2 A weaver.
3 A follower of the left hand Śākta ritual.
E.
कुल race, affix ठक्.

n. (-नं)
1 High birth, family descent.
2 Rumor, report.
3 Evil report, detraction.
4 Combat of animals, of birds, snakes, &c.
5 Cock-fighting, &c. contention of animals as a species of gambling.
6 A privity, a privy part.
7 An improper act.
m. (-नः)
The son of a female beggar.
2 A follower of the left hand Śākta ritual.
E.
कुलीन of a good family, affix श्वण्.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
1 Of a good family, well-born.
2 Of the left hand Śākta sect.
E.
कुल family, ढक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Of good parentage.
E.
कुल family, ढकञ् affix.
m. (-कः)
A dog.
E.
कुल a house, affix as before; a domestic animal.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
A field, &c. fit for or sown with a kind of bean.
E.
कुल्माष q. v. and खञ् affix; also with अञ् affix, कौल्माष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं).

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
1 Of good family or parentage.
2 Of the left hand Śākta sect.
E.
कुल family, and यञ् aff.
